svg.text: From a submitted PDF to a catalogue record
POST /v1/books or MCP add_book, files in order
hash the files in their order
qwen2.5 reads both ends of the
title pages for what is still missing
web book cards (links in the book, shops,
resolve each field by source rank;
nobody found it: empty, sources listed
